items.headline: Meta releases V-JEPA 2 world model
items.summary: V-JEPA 2 is a 1.2B-parameter video world model built on Meta's Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture, pre-trained on over 1 million hours of video and used for zero-shot robot planning in Meta's labs. Meta released code and checkpoints for commercial and research use, along with three new physical-reasoning benchmarks.
